namma-metro.name: Namma Metro (BMRCL)

flow: WhatsApp opens the official Namma Metro chat with "Hi" typed in. Tap send yourself.
Choose English or Kannada, then buy a QR ticket (single journey or group).
Pick your From and To stations in the chat — use the stations shown in this app.
Pay by UPI inside WhatsApp. The QR ticket arrives in the chat only after payment succeeds.
Tickets are valid for that service day. Show the QR at the gate.

otherChannels: ONDC apps (e.g. Namma Yatri, Rapido, Redbus, Tummoc)
Station ticket counters and smart card
